mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at City Hall under a full moon with an air quality index of 51. The ISS will be visible tonight for one minute starting at 9:21 PM, rising in the west over Mount Horeb and traveling south toward Belleville. Overnight, temperatures will drop to 49 degrees with no rain expected.

The city has announced that a section of Hwy M will be closed from October 5 to October 7 for final paving work near the future Aldi site, and remember to be cautious of potential scams regarding planning or zoning fees by only paying via check to the city.
We have a busy couple of days with Live Music at Bailey's Run and Verona Fall Fest both happening today, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market and Live Music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow.
On September 10, officers responded to a burglary on Hunters Cove Way where they apprehended a suspect after a shot was fired and the individual sustained an injury.
Culver's is currently closed for a remodel, but you can look forward to their OREO REESE'S Cheesecake flavor when they reopen tomorrow at 10:00 AM.
